## 📇 User story
As a user with disabilities, I want to be able to use the component with my assistive technology, so that I can complete my tasks independently.

## ✅ Definition of Done / Outcomes
The accessibility issue is resolved and the component works correctly with the affected assistive technology.

## 📜 Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Issue is resolved for the affected assistive technology
- [ ] Component meets relevant WCAG criteria
- [ ] Tested with the affected assistive technology

- [ ] Low - Issue may be specific to application of design system component

- [ ] High - Issue is related to component and blocks task success
